summary_md: **elvis ([@omarsar0](https://x.com/omarsar0/status/2115875068802895878))** highlights MIT Media Lab's *The Inbox as a Coordination Primitive for LLM Agent Societies* ([arXiv 2610.36264](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36264)): with push delivery an agent leading 20 negotiations re-proposes rejected options 97% of the time as context overflows, while pull-based inboxes governed by each agent's rules scale better in simulations of 1,000–16,000 agents ([DAIR summary](https://academy.dair.ai/papers/the-inbox-as-a-coordination-primitive-for-llm-agent-societies-2610.36264)).
relevance: Messaging design for large multi-agent systems.
